Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 15  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Gaza Ghetto (1998) is more recent than Kull The Conqueror (1997)". This error occurred due to the misinterpretation of the release years provided by WebSurfer from IMDb and Wikipedia evidence. While both sources consistently indicated that the latest widely recognized release date for "Gaza Ghetto" was 1985 (with the 1988 Denmark release being an anomaly and irrelevant in the comparison), the Planner misinterpreted this data and shifted the year from 1985 to 1998 without appropriate justification, contradicting the ground truth about release years. The misinterpretation stems from confusing the timeline context—IMDb listed 1985 as the general release year but also mentioned staggered international releases, which appears to have led the Planner to mistakenly fixate on the 1988 Denmark release. Consequently, instead of correctly recognizing that Kull The Conqueror (1997) was more recent than Gaza Ghetto (1985), the Planner reversed the conclusion, yielding the wrong output.
